Prefix all commit messages based on the commit type with:

* "feat:" for a new feature
* "fix:" for a bug fix

Guess the commit type based on the changes made in the files. If the changes are related to adding a new feature, use "feat:". If the changes are related to fixing a bug, use "fix:". 

You MUST use either "feat:" or "fix:" as the prefix for all commit messages. Do not use any other prefixes, especially "docs:."
